BrochureContent.Content:
New to the market is this beautifully maintained and extended three-bedroom detached bungalow positioned in Portmarnock village just off Carrick hill road lower. 

Extending to approximately 175 sq.m., the property offers a wonderfully balanced and generously proportioned layout, designed to make the very most of its remarkable setting. From the moment you step inside, there is an immediate sense of space and light, with the accommodation flowing effortlessly and the beautiful gardens drawing you through the home.

Set on mature grounds with a manicured front garden with cobble lock drive and a private secluded rear garden, Woodford cottage combines the character of an older home with the comfort of modern upgrades including double glazed windows and oil-fired central heating, wood burning stove and a bright modern kitchen with high ceilings. The property having been extended throughout the years and offers generous accommodation, excellent natural light, and superb privacy. 

This charming home offers a lifestyle that blends the calm of a mature residential setting with the vibrancy of Portmarnock coastal community

Viewing is highly recommended.
